#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Polymath product decision report rpt_252cbc9404dcac1f241e1234: fetch plan, round 2 (product-report-fetch-plan-v1).
# Generated by Polymath; do not edit. Runs every Agent Reach read of this round on THIS machine and uploads each raw output
# straight to Polymath, which parses it. Fetched content is only written to a file and uploaded: it is never run or evaluated.
# Needs mcporter (Agent Reach's Exa channel) and curl. Optional: EXA_API_KEY / JINA_API_KEY raise the pacing.
# The upload capability in UPLOAD_URL expires 2026-11-03T02:13:38Z.
set -u
REPORT=rpt_252cbc9404dcac1f241e1234
ROUND=2
UPLOAD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7200/product/report/rpt_252cbc9404dcac1f241e1234/upload/EXAMPLE-upload-token-0000000000000000000003
UPLOAD_SEP='?'
PACKETS=8
if [ -n "${EXA_API_KEY:-}" ]; then EXA_PARALLEL=8; EXA_MODE='EXA_API_KEY'; else EXA_PARALLEL=3; EXA_MODE='keyless'; fi
if [ -n "${JINA_API_KEY:-}" ]; then JINA_PARALLEL=5; JINA_GAP=1; JINA_MODE='JINA_API_KEY'; else JINA_PARALLEL=1; JINA_GAP=3; JINA_MODE='keyless'; fi
EXA_GAP=1
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "polymath-fetch: curl is required: nothing was read or uploaded"; exit 3; fi
if ! command -v mcporter >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "polymath-fetch: mcporter not found (Agent Reach: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach): the Exa packets will fail"; fi
WORK=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/polymath-report.XXXXXX") || { echo "polymath-fetch: cannot make a temporary directory"; exit 3; }
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
echo "polymath-fetch: report $REPORT round $ROUND: $PACKETS packets; Exa $EXA_PARALLEL in flight ($EXA_MODE); Jina $JINA_PARALLEL every $JINA_GAP s ($JINA_MODE)"

run_packet() {
  # $1 packet id, $2 source, $3 kind, $4 the packet's command (a function below). The output goes to a file and is uploaded.
  out="$WORK/$1.out"
  err="$WORK/$1.err"
  "$4" >"$out" 2>"$err"
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ ! -s "$out" ] && grep -q '429' "$err" 2>/dev/null; then
    sleep 5
    "$4" >"$out" 2>"$err"
    rc=$?
  fi
  bytes=$(wc -c <"$out" | tr -d ' ')
  note=''
  if grep -q '^Warning: Target URL returned error' "$out" 2>/dev/null; then note=' (the site refused the reader: the upload records it)'; fi
  if [ "$bytes" -eq 0 ]; then
    # an empty output is uploaded too (an empty body: the host records the packet as EMPTY), so the round can complete
    note=' (no output: recorded as EMPTY)'
    if grep -q '429' "$err" 2>/dev/null; then note=' (no output: recorded as EMPTY; rate limited (HTTP 429): set EXA_API_KEY to read faster)'; fi
  fi
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 120 --data-binary "@$out" -H 'content-type: text/plain' "${UPLOAD_URL}${UPLOAD_SEP}packet=$1")
  case "$code" in 2??) echo "$1" >>"$WORK/uploaded" ;; esac
  echo "polymath-fetch: $1 $2/$3: exit $rc, $bytes bytes, upload http $code$note"
}

EXA_N=0
exa() {
  run_packet "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" &
  EXA_N=$((EXA_N + 1))
  if [ "$EXA_N" -ge "$EXA_PARALLEL" ]; then wait; EXA_N=0; sleep "$EXA_GAP"; fi
}

JINA_N=0
jina() {
  run_packet "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" &
  JINA_N=$((JINA_N + 1))
  if [ "$JINA_N" -ge "$JINA_PARALLEL" ]; then wait; JINA_N=0; sleep "$JINA_GAP"; fi
}

# the packets: one exact command each (the same text as the plan's commands)
p001() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Wholesale-Electric-Wax-Candle-Melting-Warmer_1601723721615.html; }
p002() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Modern-Creative-White-Candle-Warmer-Lamps_1600715897476.html; }
p003() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Pet-Grooming-Brush-Self-Cleaning-Automatically_1600824724683.html; }
p004() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Self-Cleaning-Slicker-Remove-Shedding-Hair_1600901187399.html; }
p005() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Self-Cleaning-Soft-Slicker-Pet-Grooming_1600832798675.html; }
p006() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CLLPVZRV; }
p007() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C1RQ67PW; }
p008() { curl -s -g -m 90 ${JINA_API_KEY:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $JINA_API_KEY"} https://r.jina.ai/https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0077JOOLI; }

exa_queue() {
  :
  wait
}

jina_queue() {
  jina r2-c1-alibaba-1 alibaba page p001
  jina r2-c1-alibaba-2 alibaba page p002
  jina r2-c2-alibaba-1 alibaba page p003
  jina r2-c2-alibaba-2 alibaba page p004
  jina r2-c2-alibaba-3 alibaba page p005
  jina r2-c2-amazon-1 amazon page p006
  jina r2-c2-amazon-2 amazon page p007
  jina r2-c2-amazon-3 amazon page p008
  wait
}

exa_queue &
jina_queue &
wait
uploaded=$(grep -c . "$WORK/uploaded" 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "polymath-fetch: done: ${uploaded:-0} of $PACKETS packets uploaded for report $REPORT round $ROUND; next: product_report_status"
exit 0

how.never: do not open, read, paste or summarise the fetched pages, and do not use your agent's built-in web search or web fetch: the script uploads every raw output straight to Polymath, which parses it

how.then: call product_report_status for this report: it shows what was parsed
how.expires: the upload capability expires at 2026-11-03T02:13:38Z: run the script before then
